scientific_integrity: Claims supported by explicit finite-parameter recurrences, stochastic monotonicity coupling and Dirichlet-mixture limit; exact finite enumeration is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed d≥2 strictly positive root weights; ordinary vertices have unit attachment weights; aggregate component ordinary-leaf counts only. No full multivariate negative association theorem or CLT. Historical implicit coverage is possible, particularly from an inaccessible scanned 1991 paper; independent audit is outstanding.
title: Negative dependence and an exact covariance law for component leaves in multinomial Hoppe forests
